PMXForest — design backlog

Items parked for future consideration. Not a substitute for GitHub issues; move an item there when it becomes active work.

Release plan: 1.4.1

Agreed 2026-11-09. Development on epic/1.4.1, released through #71. In scope:

  1. forestPlot() passes statisticsLabels by its full name; Title without the full stop that R CMD check notes. Done in #72.
  2. The walkthrough content from the 2026-10-26 cold read (below). Done in #74.
  3. Reference conditioning of SCM Forest plots, and filterByModel() as a check on exclusions made elsewhere (friction item 3). Done in #74.
  4. Additive etas in nmEtaMap(), so createParamFunction() maps P = TVP + ETA(n) and verifyParamFunction() checks it (PMXFrem T28). Done in #73. PMXFrem can now test the scale gate in verifyFREMParamFunction() once it requires 1.4.1.

Cold read of the walkthrough (2026-10-26), to be done in item 2: guidance on choosing the uncertainty source (covariance, bootstrap, small bootstrap, SIR) and parametric vs empirical plots; show print_template’s output and what a mismatched reference row looks like rather than describing them; the catRef/sep warning is given twice (Sections 1 and 2) without showing the failure; and the subject and percentile numbers in Section 0 are asserted, not printed. Done in item 2, which also corrected what noVar does.

Walkthrough: second cold read (2026-11-09), left for later

Not addressed in 1.4.1:

  • Where "model" references come from (the WT/75 constant, the ; Most common comments) is left implicit, and the displacement a data-median reference causes is asserted, not shown.
  • covRef for GENO1/GENO3: “no IF() tests directly” does not match the IF(GENO1.EQ.1) lines in $PK; the warning it refers to is not shown.
  • POINT: which parameter vector gives it is not said; noBaseThetas reads as “base thetas” but is all of them.
  • Section 6: one record per subject drops time-varying covariates such as FOOD; the empirical cut points differ from the parametric ones without comment; probs and cstrPackages are not introduced.
  • thetas in the verifyParamFunction() example is never defined.
  • Style: em-dashes and possessives on things throughout the older text; “Section n” cross-references; NCI, FDC and the 2D6 levels undefined.

Old branches on the public mirror

Test3.5.3 and miscMinorFixes held nothing that main lacks and were deleted on 2026-11-09. noVarIssue (1 commit, 2025-12-19) and master (203 commits, 2023-06-25) are kept until someone reviews their commits.

Friction log for 1.3.x - user feedback, October 2026

From the internal friction log. Items 1, 2 and 6 were answered in 1.4.0; item 5 was praise.

  1. Why filterByModel() when pmxdata already excludes records? The report already imports data and excludes records through pmxdata and record types; a second route risks two answers. Positioning filterByModel() as a check on the pmxdata result (where they differ, the modeller fixes it) may answer it. Answered in 1.4.1 (#74): the walkthrough and the help say so.
  2. Why createParamFunction() when the report already has an mrgsolve translation? A second translation doubles the checking, and the secondary-parameters.R hook is hard to understand and to debug. Asks for a vignette: building the parameter function from an existing mrgsolve model, fed thetas and dfCovs; the reporter offered code. Waits for that code.
  3. Figure captions should be quicker to edit, e.g. built with paste0() from the covariate and parameter names. Concerns the report template, not the package; pass it on.
